govdocs-archive_org-KempisImitationOfChr: Thomas à Kempis’s Imitation of Christ — c. 1420 — is the beloved devotional classic, the most-read Christian book after the Bible. Its counsels on humility shaped centuries of piety. Monks and layfolk alike treasure it. The book remains the summit of devotional literature.

The vote was historic. The file belongs to the political archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
